statement: The proportion of cases with reported pre-pregnancy hypertension differs between NCFRP and PRAMS datasets.
rationale: This study aims to compare how maternal health problems are recorded in the National Fatality Review Case Reporting System (NCFRP) case series versus PRAMS population reference datasets. The design focuses on identifying differences in recording methods and prevalence of specific maternal health conditions, such as pre-pregnancy hypertension.
prior_art: The literature has not yet compared how maternal health problems are recorded in case series versus population references, which could introduce biases when assessing risk factors for SUID (SUID_manuscript_v9_clean.C12).
cannot_establish: The design cannot establish incidence or risk of SUID due to the lack of a denominator source.
